info.title: cl-router API
info.description: Canonical Convex router API with legacy Fastify compatibility. Provider credentials belong exclusively to the router deployment. Runtime validation additionally enforces relational limits, asset host policy, and routing safety requirements.

200.description: SSE events; each data frame conforms to StreamEvent.

413.description: Legacy Fastify audio exceeds upload limit

post.description: Convex accepts JSON with an HTTPS AssetReference or multipart audio. Legacy Fastify accepts multipart only. Asset references require an allowed host and runtime size limits.

get.description: Returns one policy or null with taskFamily; otherwise returns an array of policies.
Returns task rollups from the 28-day window. Convex timestamps are milliseconds and include _id/_creationTime; legacy timestamps are ISO 8601. Integer token and monetary totals are decimal strings.

post.description: Returns scoring decisions per task family, including full scored candidate details on incumbent and replacement.

adminBearerAuth.description: Independent operator credential (CL_ROUTER_ADMIN_SECRET); never distributed to inference consumers.
